sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: Narcissus serotinus is a small autumn-flowering bulbous daffodil of the south-western Iberian Peninsula, the Balearic Islands and western Morocco. Its flower stalk is usually about 8–25 cm tall; leaves may appear after flowering.

sections.title: Flower and comparison
sections.text: The stalk usually bears one white flower with a tiny yellow-orange corona. Like N. poeticus, it has a white flower with a short corona, but it flowers in autumn and has a more southerly range.

sections.title: Caution
sections.text: No food use is known. Narcissi are poisonous; do not consume any part of the plant.
